svg.text: KH.walkPose(phase): one cycle = 1.15 s = two steps. Near leg dark, far leg light, joints orange.
Each foot is planted for 62 % of the cycle; knees come from two-bone IK; the pelvis bobs 20 px twice per cycle.
Strobe: the legs every 1/8 cycle for two cycles, drawn where the walker really is (x = x0 + phase x 451.6 px).
Nothing is stretched: where a foot is planted, its copies land on top of each other and print a solid footprint.
near ankle, world x: holds while the foot is down
near ankle height: heel and toe rolls, 44 px lift
pelvis height: 20 px bob, highest at mid-stance
Shaded: near foot planted (62 % of each cycle).
